notes.title: To Last Early Access: First Steps Taken and Achievements Are Coming!
notes.content:
Dear To Last community,

The moment we've all been waiting for has finally arrived! To Last is officially in Early Access and is eagerly awaiting its first players! However, please note that the game is not yet available for download. We are still working diligently to make it fully accessible, and our goal is to have it ready for you soon.

The primary reason we’ve stepped into Early Access is to gather invaluable feedback from our community and use it to perfect the game. Throughout this process, your comments and suggestions will play a significant role in shaping the final version of To Last. Every detail of the game is being fine-tuned, and your support means the world to us.

Achievements Are Being Added!

As part of the Early Access phase, we are excited to announce that achievements are now being added to the game! These achievements will offer players an extra layer of challenge as they explore the game’s world. Each achievement is designed to encourage players to dive deeper into the story and sharpen their skills as they unravel the mysteries of To Last.

Adding achievements will enhance the To Last experience, providing not just a fun objective but also a way to uncover key aspects of the story. Currently, the first set of achievements is already in place, and we’ll continue to introduce more in upcoming updates. These will not only test your abilities but also guide you through some of the game’s hidden secrets and thrilling moments!

Our Development Progress:

Throughout Early Access, we are focusing on optimizing the game to ensure a smooth and immersive experience for everyone. We're continuously improving gameplay mechanics, expanding the maps, and polishing the UI. We’re also working hard to add more depth to the storyline and enhance the overall atmosphere.

Your feedback during this phase is crucial. If you encounter bugs or have suggestions for improvement, don’t hesitate to share them with us. With your help, we’ll shape To Last into an unforgettable experience by the time it reaches full release.

In Conclusion:

We want to thank all of you for being a part of the Early Access journey! The support and feedback from players like you are invaluable to us, and together, we’ll make this game the best it can be. Rest assured, the game will be available for download soon, and we can't wait for you to dive in.

Stay tuned, as exciting updates and surprises are on the horizon!

Thank you,
The To Last Development Team

notes.title: "To Last: Rebirth - Major Update and Development Journey"
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

About a year ago, we announced that we had completed two of the three major map designs for our horror game "To Last" and were aiming for a Q1 2024 release. Since then, we have faced many challenges, both in the game and in our circumstances. This update is prepared to explain the steps we’ve taken to advance the project, the difficulties we’ve encountered, and what you can expect in the future.

Why Were We Silent for a Year?
Over the past year, I faced significant financial difficulties that prevented me from progressing the project at the pace I wanted. Rising costs, fluctuations in exchange rates, and the challenges of managing such a large project alone slowed down the development process. However, I never gave up during this time; I continued working on the game, and today, I am proud to share the fruits of this hard work with you.

Major Changes in Game Mechanics and UI Design
One of our primary focuses during development was to diversify the game mechanics. We made significant updates to replace the old mechanics with more dynamic and immersive gameplay experiences. Additionally, the user interface (UI) design underwent a major overhaul. UI elements were completely redesigned to ensure that players can experience the game more comfortably and impressively.

Story Completed and Level Design Redone
One of the biggest achievements of the past year was the full completion of the game's story. Players will now encounter a deep and immersive narrative when they step into the dark world of "To Last." Moreover, the map and level designs have been completely reworked. Significant changes were made to level designs, particularly to better reflect the horror elements of the atmosphere.

Optimization Issues Resolved by 80%
Intensive work has been carried out on the game's optimization, and I’ve resolved approximately 80% of the optimization issues. This has greatly improved the game's performance, allowing a broader audience to experience the game smoothly. However, there’s still work to be done; I aim to resolve the remaining optimization issues before the release date.

Enemy AI and Map Expansion
During this process, I also began working on the enemy AI. The enemies players will encounter are now smarter, more strategic, and will behave in ways that heighten the sense of fear. Additionally, map expansion was also addressed during this time. Players will be able to lose themselves in a larger and more detailed world awaiting exploration.

Cover Art and New Designs
As the game developed, not just the mechanics and story but also the visual aspect underwent significant evolution. In this context, the cover art of our game has been completely renewed. The new cover art was designed to better reflect the atmosphere and the horror-filled world of the game. Additionally, new in-game visuals have been created; these visuals effectively bring out the horror elements and dark atmosphere of the game.

Looking Ahead
I want you to know that the game is still in development, and I continue to work hard to reach my goals. Feedback and critiques from all of you are extremely valuable to me during this process. I take all comments into consideration to make the project even better.

I’d like to thank all the players who have supported me through this long and challenging journey. I look forward to sharing more progress with you in the next update about "To Last."

Thank you, and may you have terrifying moments!

— Developer

notes.title: TO LAST Design Progress Completed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269421/6a4a17ed8445be46ece4f3e4f9ba4755afc20187.jpg[/img]
Hello, we have completed two of the 3 major map designs of the "To Last" horror game that we develop regularly. With this news, we aim to release our game in the first quarter of 2024, with the wish list reaching +1000 people. There will also be significant changes in the design images. We collaborate with our teammates on music packages, story writing and many other events.

[b]So Why Was the Steam Page Opened So Early?[/b]
We wanted to open early due to the rising Turkish inflation and the dollar exchange rate not being stable.

[b]How Many People in Our Team?[/b]
We have a dispersed team and 1 person is the main developer, the other people are paid only for that work. Then we are done with that person.

[b]Are Designs Fixed?[/b]
Yes, the designs are now fixed. Now you have seen the atmosphere of our game in sample pictures.

[b]Are You Open to Criticism?[/b]
Yes, we are definitely open to all kinds of criticism.
